# dsh-herdr-bridge
Report DeepSeek Harness agent activity to the herdr pane hosting the dsh process. herdr's status bar
then shows the pane as an agent with live `working` / `blocked` / `idle` states. No herdr changes r
ows the pane as an agent with live `working` / `blocked` / `idle` states. No herdr changes required.
## How it works
herdr injects `HERDR_SOCKET_PATH` and `HERDR_PANE_ID` into every pane command. This plugin reads the
m, listens to dsh's `agent/status`, `agent/created`, `agent/disposed`, and `approval/request` events
, and reports the aggregated state over that socket. Outside a herdr pane it is a no-op.

## Limits
- herdr shows one agent per pane, so multiple agents/subagents aggregate into that pane's row. Split

them by running one dsh per pane.
- A graceful exit clears the reported state; a SIGKILL/crash cann

ot, so herdr keeps the last state until the pane reopens.
- Editing the plugin file needs a dsh rest
art (the module cache is not hot-reloaded).
